resources.description:
Network: {network}

A new device entry and all applicable entities will be created within Home Assistant for each selected resource (the behavior can be inverted for clients by changing the filter method). Individual entities can then be disabled as desired.

data.consider_home: Consider home interval (applicable to device tracker entities only)
data.prefix_network_name: Add network name as a prefix for all non-network entities
data.suffix_connection_type: Add connection type (wired or wireless) as a suffix for all client devices and entities
data.remove_stale_clients: Remove client devices away for (days, 0 = never)

data_description.remove_stale_clients: A wired or wireless client that has not been connected for this many days is removed with its entities, unless you renamed it, gave it an area or a label, or customized one of its entities. It comes back if it reconnects (at the next reload). Useful for devices that change their MAC address on every connection.

set_blocked_apps.name: Set blocked apps
set_blocked_apps.description: Set the blocked apps for a profile.

blocked_apps.name: Blocked apps
blocked_apps.description: (Required) List of apps to block. Passing an empty list will unblock all supported apps.

target_profile.name: Target profile(s)
target_profile.description: (Optional) Name(s) or ID(s) of profile(s) to set. Defaults to all profiles if not specified.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Optional) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) in which desired profile(s) are located. Defaults to all networks if not specified.

remove_stale_devices.name: Remove stale client devices
remove_stale_devices.description: Removes client devices that have not been connected for a number of days. Renamed or customized devices, the network, the eeros and the profiles are never removed. Returns the list of devices.

days.name: Days
days.description: Minimum number of days without a connection.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only list the devices that would be removed (default).

remove_unknown.name: Include undated devices
remove_unknown.description: Also remove, whatever their age, devices eero no longer reports and that the integration has never seen connected. Use it once to clear a backlog of dead devices, with a dry run first.
